title: Nadodi Pattukkaran
desc: Sundaram, a musician, travels from one place to another along with his troupe. One day, the troupe drives away a group of robbers who terrorise a village and subsequently, they settle there.

title: Sugamana Sumaigal
desc: Murthy is the sole breadwinner of his large family. However, when he discovers that he has cancer and his days are numbered, he challenges fate and does everything he can to secure his family.

title: Nee Naan Nizhal
desc: Anwar investigates the death of five Indians in Malaysia. While it looks like a racial attack at first, the case takes a turn when he learns that the victims were online friends with the same girl.

title: Vidiyum Vari Kaathiru
desc: Raja's life philosophy captivates millionaire Rajaratnam during a chance encounter. Soon, the tycoon seeks a cure for his daughter's disability by roping Raja into matrimony with his daughter.

title: Sema Ragalai
desc: In order to go abroad in search of his dream job, Satya agrees to kidnap his friend's lover. However, he abducts the wrong woman and is stuck with her.
